title: The Great Kite Chase in Sunflower Town
description: In the cheerful town of Sunflower, four best friends set out on a fun-filled adventure to catch a magical kite that leads them through fields, rivers, and into the sky!

scenes.description: Arjun, a lively boy in a blue shirt, spots a shimmering golden kite soaring high above the sunflower fields under a bright morning sky.
scenes.visual_prompt: A boy in a blue shirt pointing excitedly at a golden kite flying over endless sunflower fields, cheerful storybook style
scenes.narration: One sunny morning, Arjun spots a golden kite dancing in the breeze over the sunflower fields.
scenes.subtitle: The Golden Kite

scenes.description: Arjun calls Sia, Kabir, and Lila, and together they race through the colorful fields, trying to follow the kite's trail.
scenes.visual_prompt: Four children running through bright yellow sunflower fields, chasing a sparkling golden kite in the sky
scenes.narration: He calls his friends, and soon the four are running together, laughing and chasing the magical kite.
scenes.subtitle: Chasing the Wind

scenes.description: The kite glides over a river where the friends hop onto a wooden raft, paddling fast as the wind carries the kite across.
scenes.visual_prompt: Four kids on a wooden raft paddling down a sparkling blue river, the golden kite ahead in the sky
scenes.narration: The kite floats over the river, and the friends paddle their raft as fast as they can to keep up.
scenes.subtitle: Across the River

scenes.description: The friends reach a small hill where the kite swirls in circles, as if waiting for them, before shooting up into the clouds.
scenes.visual_prompt: Children standing on a grassy hill, looking up at the golden kite swirling above them before flying higher into the clouds
scenes.narration: They climb the hill, hearts racing, just as the golden kite swirls playfully and then soars into the clouds.
scenes.subtitle: The Waiting Kite

scenes.description: The kite magically pulls them upward, and suddenly they are floating among fluffy clouds, surrounded by rainbow-colored birds.
scenes.visual_prompt: Children floating among fluffy white clouds with rainbow-colored birds, holding onto a golden kite string
scenes.narration: Holding the string tight, they rise into the sky, flying with rainbow birds and touching the clouds.
scenes.subtitle: Flying High

scenes.description: The kite gently brings them back to the sunflower fields, where it lands softly in Arjun’s hands, glowing warmly.
scenes.visual_prompt: A golden kite landing in a boy's hands in a field of sunflowers, glowing in the evening sunlight
scenes.narration: The golden kite leads them back home, where it lands softly in Arjun’s hands, shining like a treasure.
scenes.subtitle: The Treasure Returns
